show_title: Capital Allocators – Inside the Institutional Investment Industry
title: Kim Lew – The Carnegie Way (Capital Allocators, EP.52)

reader_summary.headline: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators.
reader_summary.overview: I'm Ted Sides, and this is Capital Allocators. This show is an open exploration of the people and process behind capital allocation. Through conversations with leaders in the money game, we learn how these holders of the keys to the kingdom allocate their time and their capital.

key_points.text: You can keep up to date by visiting Capital Allocatorspodcast.com.

key_points.text: My guest on today's show is Kim Liu, the vice president and chief investment officer of Carnegie Corporation.
key_points.evidence_quote: My guest on today's show is Kim Liu, the vice president and chief investment officer of Carnegie Corporation, where she's responsible for the investment and oversight of the Corporation's $3.5 billion Foundation.

key_points.text: Kim joined Carnegie in 2007 after spending a dozen years at the Ford Foundation.
key_points.evidence_quote: Kim joined Carnegie in 2007 after spending a dozen years at the Ford Foundation.

key_points.text: She's also a trustee of Ariel Investments, the board chair of the Stevens Cooperative Schools.
key_points.evidence_quote: She's also a trustee of Ariel Investments, the board chair of the Stevens Cooperative Schools, and a member of the Investment Committees of the Girl Scouts of America and the ACLU.
